correctness.rationale: The edge-deletion/Euler-trail correspondence fixes quantifiers and exact linear length. Unique short directed cycles give four balanced triples; exact 2- and 3-edge open-walk counts yield four unbalanced terms summing to 10*2^n-46. By the published super-edge-connectivity theorem, at most three arc removals disconnecting active vertices can only isolate a constant vertex; direct divergence enumerates exactly five obstructing choices per constant, hence ten exceptional triples and 10*2^n-56 total. A standalone exhaustive implementation checks n=4..7, all 388,560 tested deletion triples, independently reconstructing graph connectivity and degree patterns.
